name: Kamat Hotels (India) Ltd
title: Kamat Hotels (India) Ltd - 526668 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Hotel operator with no capacity discipline issues; Q4 revenue up 19% to INR 110 cr and EBITDA margin 29%, but FY27 top line faces ~INR 50 cr loss from IRA Mumbai exit and no numeric guidance was given.

utilisation.quote: occupancy also dropped, which holistically as a company we have seen

capex.quote: new project executions would be challenging because of material supply availability today

triggers.label: IRA Mumbai exit removes ~INR 50 cr revenue
triggers.quote: IRA Mumbai was contributing top-line almost INR 50 CR. That INR 50 CR is now not going to be there.

triggers.label: ARR falling across verticals
triggers.quote: if we look at the ARR that has been falling across all our verticals

triggers.label: Delayed openings: Dehradun to Sept
triggers.quote: We estimate it to come in September.

triggers.label: Opening 150-200 keys in FY27
triggers.quote: This year we should be looking at operating additionally opening at least 150 to 200 keys.

guidance.quote: This year we should be looking at operating additionally opening at least 150 to 200 keys.

guidance.metric: EBITDA uplift from IRA Mumbai exit
guidance.quote: EBITDA will go up by anywhere between INR 1 CR to INR 2 CR at least.

red_flags.label: Revenue loss from IRA Mumbai exit
red_flags.quote: That INR 50 CR is now not going to be there.

red_flags.label: Labour cost up after wage code and one-time payouts
red_flags.quote: the wage code impact has been about INR 4 crore, which is there to stay.

red_flags.label: CFO transition
red_flags.quote: our CFO who has moved on

evasions.quote: I would not like to speculate anything right now.
Let's give other a chance. Let's come back, sir, if you don't mind
